name: osis
description: OSIS Agent plugin for Kimi Code: starts (or reuses) the local OSIS Agent Broker over stdio and ships the OSIS modeling skills.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the local OSIS modeling app
interface.longDescription: Select an OSIS instance, look up the real OSIS Python API and run Python against the open model. All traffic stays on 127.0.0.1 through the OSIS Agent Broker.
